tools.name: verify_email
tools.description:
Check an email address: syntax, mail server, mailbox (when the server allows), disposable, role account,
    typo suggestion, risk score and an accept/review/reject recommendation. 1 credit.

tools.name: validate_phone
tools.description:
Check a phone number: validity, E.164 format, line type, region, time zone, original carrier assignment
    (US), VoIP, risk score and recommendation. Numbers without + need default_country (e.g. "US"). 1 credit.

tools.name: carrier_lookup
tools.description:
US/Canada numbers: the carrier serving the number today, whether it was ported, port date, current line
    type and VoIP, from a live number-portability lookup. 3 credits; not charged if unavailable.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description:
Check an IPv4/IPv6 address: approximate location, network owner (ASN), Tor exit, datacenter/hosting,
    risk score and recommendation. 1 credit.

tools.name: verify_contact
tools.description:
Check whether a name and/or phone match the domain registration records that list this email.
    Returns match levels only (match / partial / no_match), never the records. 1 credit.

tools.name: reverse_phone
tools.description:
Who is behind a US/Canada phone number. standard: caller ID name (10 credits if found).
    premium: caller ID plus names, emails and phones from domain registration records (25 if contacts are
    found, 10 if only a caller ID). Nothing found: free.

tools.name: reverse_email
tools.description:
Who is behind an email address: names and phone numbers from domain registration records.
    10 credits if found, free otherwise.

tools.name: create_bulk_job
tools.description:
Check up to 100,000 values in the background, charged per unique value like single lookups (reverse
    lookups only when found). Returns the job; poll get_bulk_job, then get_bulk_results.

tools.name: get_bulk_job
tools.description: Status and progress of a bulk job. Free.

tools.name: get_bulk_results
tools.description: Results of a bulk job, one page at a time (has_next tells you to ask for the next page). Free.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your credit balance and usage today and over the last 30 days. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_contact · Private data: verify_contact, reverse_phone, reverse_email · Public sink: verify_email, verify_contact, reverse_email · Destructive: validate_phone.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_contact · Private data: verify_contact, reverse_phone, reverse_email · Public sink: verify_email, verify_contact, reverse_email · Destructive: validate_phone

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
